heading: Per-schema FIFO TTL queue
text:
### Per-schema FIFO TTL queue [LDTL.3.1]

In the default mode, each `ttl`-lifecycle schema maintains a
**per-schema FIFO TTL queue** ordered by assertion time.  Because all
facts of the same schema share the same TTL duration, assertion order
equals expiry order: the oldest-asserted fact always expires first.

| Operation | Time | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Fact assert (TTL) | O(1) — append to schema TTL tail | No heap sift |
| Fact retract (explicit) | O(1) — intrusive doubly-linked splice | Must remove from queue |
| TTL tick | O(expired × log n_ttl_schemas + n_ttl_schemas) | Merge the schemas' queue fronts by deadline, then entry ([LDTL.6.1]); expire each front while its deadline is at or before the tick's instant |

`n_ttl_schemas` is the number of `ttl`-lifecycle schemas in the DSC — a
compile-time constant, not a function of WM population, so the merge's log
factor is a constant too: about 6 for 50 TTL schemas.
